{{Quote|Captain Lunker here is in charge of the operation. He will take you to Jan-gwa city.|Captain Gregar Typho|audio=CaptainLunker-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
'''Lunker''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] security [[Captain/Legends|captain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was tasked with watching [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on Naboo. During that time, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], came to Naboo to protect [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Gungan [[Youngling/Legends|child]], from abduction by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. Lunker and Captain [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] met with Skywalker and Tano in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Skywalker ordered Tano to go with Lunker to Page's house in Jan-gwa city, while he stayed with Typho. Skywalker and Tano later saved Page from Bane's [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|abduction attempt]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Alright, go with the Gungan. I'll be there shortly.|Anakin Skywalker, to Ahsoka Tano on Lunker|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Lunker was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Children of the Force" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Lunker was tasked with watching [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]], a small [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="Children of the Force" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] tasked the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] with kidnapping [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]]. One of the targets of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] bounty hunter was [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]], a Gungan child living in Jan-gwa city. However, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] discovered Bane's plan and dispatched<ref name="Children of the Force" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="RotS" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to Naboo to protect Page.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

[[File:Jan-gwa_CotF.png|thumb|left|250px|Jan-gwa city, which Lunker had to watch]]
Lunker, along with<ref name="Children of the Force" /> Captain [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]]<ref name="Episode Guide Children of the Force">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> from the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], rendezvoused with the arriving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Children of the Force" /> in the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Royal Hangar]] in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Episode Guide Children of the Force" /> Typho told Skywalker and Tano that Page's family had been notified and introduced Lunker to the two. Skywalker ordered Tano to go with Lunker to Page's house in Jan-gwa city, while he stayed with Typho for some time. Lunker brought Tano to Jan-gwa city, and soon Skywalker rejoined his Padawan. After a brief brawl between Bane and the Jedi, Skywalker and Tano saved Page from Bane's attempt to [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|abduct]] her, and they arrested the bounty hunter.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==Personality and traits==
Lunker was an [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] Gungan who had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and blue and brown skin.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==Equipment==
While on Naboo, Lunker wore a dark blue and brown [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] over a blue and brown tunic and brown pants.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lunker first appeared in "[[Children of the Force]]," the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="Episode Guide Children of the Force" /> Prior to the character's conception, "Lunker" was the name of the main Gungan character in the television series in Series Director [[Dave Filoni]]'s early ideas and concept storylines for the show.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
